ontology: Domain: river-valley flood damage (this is a flood study, not fire, not earthquake — frame accordingly). Processes such surveys consider include: water draining safely through debris; debris forming a dam that holds; water ponding behind debris and later releasing suddenly; new slope failures on other reaches; continued flooding downstream only; or nothing further happening. These are vocabulary, not answers: you may adopt, adapt, or reject any of them, but your set must stay open and include a nothing-happens story with real weight. Ground every weight in the ledger below, not in the vocabulary above.
prompt_framing: Context: a river-valley damage survey, one pre-cutoff snapshot, anonymous reaches (Alpha upstream, Beta downstream), one anonymized tributary. Below is the evidence ledger (pre-cutoff aggregates only).
